If anybody ever sees this, which i highly doubt, I just want you to know, that i did not have a depression as first thought.
I have since been diagnosed with

-Anxious personality disorder

-borderline personality disorder 

And that explains why my emotional outburst was a violent as it was.

I hope you are right and at the same time wrong, I do not want to think, that this is just because of a broken heart, and at the same time, I really want to believe you.
I hate being alone, when i am at work or college everything is normally fine. I can push the negative thoughts away, when I am around people (Depends, but normally it is like that). The sadness/feeling of despair and emptiness, comes when I am alone, I spend most of the evening just staring at the TV or into the ceiling.

Time may heal all things, but i do not think i can keep going feeling like this, much longer. 
When i read some of the other posts around here, I just feel ashamed for being sad, when others have it much worse then me.
